name: Rustic Home
old_description: If we don't have what you're looking for in our shop... we'll have it made and customized just for you!
about:
Rustic Home operates a retail showroom in Albuquerque, New Mexico. The business is owned by Norma, who runs the store with a partner referred to as Daisy. The founding year is not publicly disclosed.

The store specializes in rustic-style home furnishings, including furniture pieces that are handmade in Mexico to order. Each item features intentional distressing, cracks, and color variations that give it a unique character. Beyond furniture, the shop carries throw blankets, pillows, incense, and other Southwestern decor accents. Custom orders are accepted for pieces not in stock.

Rustic Home serves individual consumers and interior designers seeking rustic and Southwestern aesthetic pieces for residential spaces. Customers visit the physical store at 9304 4th St NW for in-person selection, though the business also facilitates made-to-order arrangements through its Mexican workshop partners.

The company emphasizes the one-of-a-kind nature of its handmade goods, noting that no two pieces match exactly but coordinate well together. This variability, along with personalized service and a frequently updated inventory, is presented as the core appeal.

name: Rustic furniture designs LLC
old_description: We’re grateful for every family that invites our work into their home.
about:
Rustic Furniture Designs LLC operates from Orrville, Ohio, where it produces handcrafted solid wood furniture for residential customers. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year or ownership structure, and no founders are named on its website.

The shop builds a range of indoor furniture including dining tables, chairs, barstools, coffee tables, end tables, sofa tables, TV stands, storage pantries, wall shelves, charcuterie boards, and specialty racks. All pieces are described as solid wood with no veneers or particle board, and the company invites custom work requests. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are published.

The primary customer base is families furnishing their homes, with products marketed as heirloom-quality items built for generations. The catalog spans farmhouse, midcentury, and modern collections, suggesting appeal to a variety of interior design preferences.

The company emphasizes durability and material honesty as its differentiators: every piece is handcrafted from solid wood, free of veneers or particle board, and positioned as artisan work meant to last. This focus on traditional joinery and solid lumber is presented as the core reason the business exists.

name: RxSource (NJ) Inc.
old_description: Putting patients first has been at the heart of everything we do since RxSource was founded in 2005. We have a belief in
about:
RxSource (NJ) Inc. was founded in 2005 in Canada and now operates from its U.S. headquarters in West Deptford, New Jersey, with additional facilities in Richmond Hill, Ontario, and Dublin, Ireland. The company began as a Canadian clinical trial supply provider and expanded internationally, opening its Irish site in 2017 and its New Jersey site in 2018 before relocating and expanding the U.S. facility in 2025.

The firm provides end-to-end clinical trial supply services to pharmaceutical and biotech sponsors, including sourcing of commercial products (comparators, co-medications, rescue medications, ancillaries), packaging and labeling under temperature-controlled conditions (ambient, refrigerated, frozen), global temperature-controlled distribution through its own facilities and a network of partner depots, Importer of Record services, and EU Qualified Person (QP) release. Its quality system is supported by a TrackWise EQMS, and the company reports 27% growth in units packaged, 103% growth in packaging runs, and 570% growth in labels printed over the prior year.

RxSource serves the global pharmaceutical and biotechnology industry, specifically clinical trial sponsors who need comparator sourcing, packaging, labeling, storage, and distribution for investigational medicinal products. Its customer base includes sponsors running trials across North America and Europe.

The company states that its patient-first mission—aiming to improve the lives of 10 million patients in 10 years—drives its culture. It differentiates itself through industry-leading timelines, flexible capacity planning, an experienced team, and a quality-first approach that goes beyond regulatory requirements.

name: S&W Wire Co
old_description: Textile covering consisting of pure fiberglass yarn, which is wrapped, treated, and then heat fused to the underlying conductor. Can be constructed with a single layer or double layer of glass yarn.
about:
S&W Wire Company operates from Cranberry Township, Pennsylvania, where it was founded in 1988 to meet demand for fast-turnaround production of glass- and Kapton-insulated magnet wire. The company remains privately held; founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The firm manufactures a range of magnet wire products, including enameled wire, polyglass-insulated wire (pure fiberglass yarn wrapped, treated, and heat-fused to the conductor in single or double layers), and seamless hollow conductor tubing. It also provides wire testing services for specification and batch uniformity, custom stocking programs aligned with customer supply-chain schedules, and a respooling service that sells exact lengths without requiring full-reel purchases. Inventory exceeds 150,000 pounds across more than 200 sizes, backed by a computerized link to North America’s largest wire inventories.

S&W Wire serves magnet-wire buyers of all sizes, from small prototype orders to high-volume production runs, offering both bare and insulated wire in round, square, and rectangular profiles. Customers span industries that rely on magnet wire for motors, transformers, and generators, though the company does not publicly list specific sectors.

The company emphasizes quick turnaround, no minimum order quantities, competitive pricing on scheduled lead-time orders, and daily-updated online inventory with instant quote capability. Its Wire On Demand suite bundles exact-length cutting, stocking programs, and testing to reduce customer lead times and inventory costs.

name: SEC America
old_description: SEC Tractor Trailer Electrical Interfaces provide electrical compatibility when electrical specifications between tractor and trailer do not match.
about:
SEC America Corp operates from South Burlington, Vermont, where it has maintained a track record of more than 30 years in power conversion solutions. The company functions as a design and engineering firm that also assembles its products in the United States, though no founding year or original founders are disclosed in public materials.

The company develops and manufactures rugged power conversion equipment including trailer electrical interfaces, DC‑DC converters, battery backup systems, and sealed converters. Its South Burlington facility houses engineering labs for rapid prototype development and field‑test monitoring, as well as transformer and metal fabrication capabilities that support design management and product refinement. SEC America warehouses an extensive inventory of standard off‑the‑shelf units and can ship orders placed before 1:00 PM the same day; it also offers custom mechanical and electrical design, private labeling, and warranty repair services.

SEC America serves industrial and consumer specialty markets, with a notable focus on the transportation sector where its trailer electrical interfaces resolve compatibility mismatches between tractors and trailers. The company’s design/build process targets OEMs, encouraging modification of existing designs for small‑to‑medium runs and pursuing full custom development when high volumes justify the investment.

SEC America emphasizes rugged, built‑to‑last products assembled in the U.S.A., backed by a two‑year limited warranty. The firm cites continuous communication with its manufacturing partners as a driver of cost‑effective assemblies and packaging, and it positions its in‑house fabrication and rapid‑delivery capability as key differentiators for customers needing quick turnaround on new designs.
